title: Unity Catalog model-version dependencies: a new resource type needs its DependencyType enum member and its wiring in get_model_version_dependencies together
answers: Why does registering a model to Unity Catalog fail with an unknown enum label when a new resource type is emitted as a dependency?
How do I record a new kind of model resource (for example a model service or endpoint) as a dependency when registering a model version in Unity Catalog?
Where are model resources like langchain tools or table dependencies mapped to Unity Catalog DependencyType values?
Which files must change when adding a new DATABRICKS_* dependency type for Unity Catalog model registration?
body:
Path: mlflow/store/_unity_catalog/registry/rest_store.py:get_model_version_dependencies builds the dependency list (DATABRICKS_TABLE, UC_FUNCTION, UC_CONNECTION, MODEL_ENDPOINT, UC_MODEL_SERVICE, ...) for a model's resources that is carried on the CreateModelVersionRequest when a model is registered to UC through the legacy/proxy path.
Rule: Adding a dependency type is a two-part change that must land in one PR. (1) Add the member to the DependencyType enum in mlflow/protos/databricks_uc_registry_messages.proto, then regenerate mlflow/protos/databricks_uc_registry_messages_pb2.py and _pb2.pyi with dev/generate_protos.py (pinned protoc + mypy-protobuf). (2) Add a `_DEP_TYPE_*` string constant next to the existing ones in rest_store.py and an extend call using _fetch_langchain_dependency_from_model_resources with the matching ResourceType value, inside the resources branch of get_model_version_dependencies.
Symptom: Emitting the new DATABRICKS_* type string before the enum member exists makes proto conversion fail with 'unknown enum label', so model-version registration to UC errors out.
Constraints: Entries with on_behalf_of_user set are excluded, matching the other types. The old-model branch (the else path for models without resources) is not changed by this pattern. Tests to extend: test_create_model_version_with_resources and test_create_model_version_with_invoker_resources in tests/store/_unity_catalog/model_registry/test_unity_catalog_rest_store.py.
applies: Adding a new resource type to Unity Catalog model-version dependency registration on the legacy/proxy path in MLflow.
says: Registering a model version in the catalog fails when declaring new resource dependencies.
Model version creation crashes with an unrecognized type error when saving dependent services.
Allow model versions in the catalog to track new upstream endpoint and service dependencies.
Catalog model registration errors out when saving models linked to external tools.
Enable registering models in the catalog alongside their linked endpoint resources.
search: Adding a new resource dependency type for Unity Catalog model-version registration on the legacy path requires defining the DependencyType enum member in mlflow/protos/databricks_uc_registry_messages.proto and regenerating protobuf bindings via dev/generate_protos.py. Simultaneously, a matching _DEP_TYPE_* constant and _fetch_langchain_dependency_from_model_resources call must be added inside mlflow/store/_unity_catalog/registry/rest_store.py:get_model_version_dependencies. Both parts must land in a single PR to prevent CreateModelVersionRequest proto serialization failing with unknown enum label errors. Entries with on_behalf_of_user set are excluded, and tests in tests/store/_unity_catalog/model_registry/test_unity_catalog_rest_store.py must be extended.
